faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NSD Akashvani Production Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Production Assistant post is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Production Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree from a recognized university to be eligible for the Production Assistant position. This is the primary educational requirement for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying is between 21 years and 50 years. Candidates falling within this age bracket are eligible to apply for the Production Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Production Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 1500 per day. This is a contractual position, and the payment is structured on a daily basis.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NSD Akashvani Production Assistant job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with necessary documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Production Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Production Assistant role will involve a Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to clear both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for a contractual position, and the terms of employment will be as per the contract agreement.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application. Ensure all required documents are included.
